description: Record your signed acceptance of the current Terms of Use (required once per Terms version, before your first write). Produce the signature with geode-local-signer accept_terms.

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp that was signed (from accept_terms)

name: geode_accept_terms
title: Accept the Terms of Use
